caption.zh: 审查面板：一次真实会话里的计数与判定列表
caption.en: Review panel: counts and verdicts from a real session

zh: 破坏性命令先由本地正则按工具名与参数模式识别，这一层不调用模型
只有第一层命中才调用一次独立的小模型复核，拒绝时必须给出理由
面板实时显示每一次判定，送审的调用追加到本地审计日志
任何异常路径一律放行——最坏表现是这道门什么都没做
en: Destructive commands are caught by local regexes on the tool name and arguments, with zero model calls
Only a first-layer hit triggers one independent small-model review, which must give a reason when it denies
The panel shows every verdict live, and reviewed calls are appended to a local audit log
Every failure path allows the call, so the worst case is that the gate does nothing
Not a security boundary: it reduces accidental damage, it does not stop malicious code
Classification uses tool names and argument patterns, not tool-declared types
It never answers ask; an unavailable model degrades to allow
Parallel dangerous calls can still exhaust the local audit ring buffer
